data.narrative:
Periodic Labs is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Liam Fedus and Ekin Dogus Cubuk that has raised $300M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader comp universe of 16 AI & Software peers, including one public company (Palantir) and eight private firms such as Waymo, Figure AI, and Scale AI, though direct peer multiples proved insufficiently granular for reliable triangulation.

Given the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with matching valuation tiers, a Stage-Progression method was the primary applicable approach. Using the $300M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to subsequent stage, this method implies a valuation of $750M. This reflects typical venture progression mechanics for companies at this funding level and stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $638M to $862M, with a median of $750M. This range is derived from a single methodological anchor, which limits confidence intervals compared to multi-method triangulation. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly-matched peer data (no Seed-stage AI & Software companies of comparable raise size in the dataset), making extrapolation from stage-based progression the primary determinant rather than market comparables. Further due diligence on unit economics, customer concentration, and burn rate would refine this estimate as additional company-specific data becomes available.
